facts.fact: Dhanu wears a finger-long goat-horn whistle on a thong against his skin: the Glass Lakes way signal is two long notes and one short for 'come on, it's clear', three short for 'turn back'.
facts.why: needed because the beat shows the whistle and its signal.

facts.fact: Kunal has read the crown's cover sheet to the council naming 'a way beneath the Shilak Cairn' and has never heard of such a way; Ila has not seen the sheet.
facts.why: needed because Kunal's stated reason for keeping Ila close; follows F431.

facts.fact: The cliff notch behind Ewe's Rest is called 'the clerk's stoop' in Kunal's hill speech; Ila writes it as he says it.
facts.why: needed because the nightly name trade (F462) continues on page.

facts.fact: Mini is six and travels with Dhanu and Gauri on the pony when they go ahead by the short way; Ewe's Rest is left empty except for Kunal and Ila.
facts.why: needed because Dhanu and Gauri leave, and the child must be accounted for.

facts.fact: The Hollow Moon is a wide white bowl north of Ewe's Rest with a fan of loose stone on its west side; its far rim lies about 10 degrees west of north, and the spyglass glint comes from a black outcrop on the west lip at 210 degrees.
facts.why: needed because the ending requires a concrete watcher position and sets up ch 9.
